description: Smoke task for pages_env: pre_task launches Apple Pages and waits for its window to register with LaunchServices, then opens a new blank document via AppleScript (bypassing the template chooser). The verifier passes when the Pages process is running with a registered window. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (preferences seeded, upgrade modal suppressed, app launches with a usable blank document) and to give a known-good interactive view via `gym-anything run … -i --open-vnc`.
natural_language: Wait. Apple Pages is launched before the agent gets control; no action is required.
